# archcast

name: archcast
version: 0.1.0
language: Rust (edition 2024)
category: CLI / Architecture & Flow Report Compiler
backends: cpu-simd-rayon (default: memchr + wide::f64x4 + rayon + resvg/tiny-skia/gif), webgpu-hybrid (optional feature: gpu via wgpu WGSL compute)

## Purpose
Deterministic compiler between AI-friendly YAML/JSON architecture specifications and fixed-style visual deliverables (HTML with browser WebGPU/Canvas2D motion, standalone root-level SVG files, optional raster PNG & animated flow-pulse GIF) + canonical Markdown/Mermaid documents. Also reverse-extracts existing HTML+SVG overview pages into canonical YAML and Markdown.

## Commands
- `archcast render <INPUT> -o <DIR> [--format all|both|media|html|svg|md|png|gif] [--png] [--gif] [--gif-mode overlay|delta] [--scale <F32>] [--gif-scale <F32>] [--frames <N>] [--fps <N>] [--static-html] [--theme <ID_OR_PATH>] [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--backend auto|cpu|gpu] [--strict] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: input=input-path, output_dir=output-dir
  outputs: <stem>.html (report-html), <stem>[-<diag_id>].svg (diagram-svg), <stem>.md (doc-markdown), optional <stem>[-<diag_id>].png (diagram-png), optional <stem>[-<diag_id>].gif (diagram-gif), archcast.log (log)
- `archcast theme list [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: read-only
- `archcast theme show <THEME> [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: read-only
  note: prints resolved YAML on stdout by default, or JSON envelope with --json
- `archcast theme create <ID> [--from <THEME>] [--file <PATH>] [--display-name <NAME>] [--set <KEY=VALUE>...] [--force] [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: file=input-file
  outputs: <themes_dir>/<ID>.yaml (theme-yaml)
- `archcast theme update <ID> [--file <PATH>] [--display-name <NAME>] [--set <KEY=VALUE>...] [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: file=input-file
  outputs: <themes_dir>/<ID>.yaml (theme-yaml)
- `archcast theme delete <ID> [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
- `archcast theme export <THEME> <OUTPUT> [--themes-dir <DIR>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: output=output-file
  outputs: <OUTPUT> (theme-yaml)
- `archcast extract <INPUT> -o <DIR> [--yaml-only] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: input=input-path, output_dir=output-dir
  outputs: <stem>.yaml (spec-yaml), <stem>.md (doc-markdown), archcast.log (log)
- `archcast validate <INPUT> [--json]`
  effects: read-only
  io: input=input-file
- `archcast init <OUTPUT> [--title <TITLE>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: output=output-file
  outputs: <OUTPUT> (spec-yaml)
- `archcast info [--backend auto|cpu|gpu] [--json]`
  effects: read-only

## Spec Schema (v1) & Theme Schema (v1)
- spec root: schema_version (1), theme (optional id or file path), doc_title, title, lead[], diagrams[], flow_table
- diagram: id, heading, note, svg_title, canvas_title, subtitles[], columns[], edges[], callouts[], warning, footer
- column: id, title, width (optional), cards[]
- card: id, title, accent (Tone), badge (optional), align_with (optional card id), lines[], subcards[], footer
- edge: kind (direct|bus|loop_left|bottom_route), from[], to[], label, bus_slot
- flow_table: id, heading, note, groups[] -> { name, tone, rows[] -> { action, trigger, version, version_tone, entry[], downstream[], note } }, hint
- bundled themes: starlink-light (default), obsidian-neon, paper-editorial, blueprint-ink, catppuccin-mocha
- theme resolution priority: CLI --theme > spec.theme > default (starlink-light); lookup order: direct file path > external themes dir (--themes-dir / ARCHCAST_THEMES_DIR / $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/archcast/themes / ~/.config/archcast/themes) > bundled built-in
- theme extension & overrides: YAML/JSON files support `extends: <parent-id>` (deep-merge partial overrides, max depth 4); creating/updating a built-in ID writes an external override, and `theme delete` removes the override and restores the bundled default
- theme id rules: 1..=64 chars, starts with ASCII alphanumeric, only [a-zA-Z0-9_-]
- theme config groups & `--set <dot.path>=<value>` keys:
  - top: display_name, color_scheme (light|dark), is_dark (true|false), extends (YAML)
  - surface: page_bg, card_bg, card_border, card_shadow, svg_bg (#RRGGBB), node_bg, node_border, subcard_bg, subcard_border, callout_bg, callout_border, code_bg, codebox_bg, codebox_border
  - ink: page_fg, lead_fg, note_fg, code_fg, svg_title, svg_subtitle, svg_meta, col_header, node_title, node_text, node_mono, node_footer, subcard_title
  - chrome: toc_link, h2_accent, btn_bg, btn_fg, btn_border, btn_hover_bg, pill_bg, pill_fg, edge_spine, edge_stroke, edge_label_bg, edge_label_fg, badge_opacity, ver_bg_alpha
  - table: head_bg, head_fg, border, row_border, hover_bg, grp_bg, grp_fg, cnt_fg, small_fg, down_fg
  - warning: hint_bg, hint_fg, hint_accent, banner_bg, banner_border, banner_accent, banner_title, banner_body
  - tones: default, muted, blue, orange, green, emerald, amber, purple, gold, red
  - motion: pulse_hex (4 comma-separated #RRGGBB), beacon_red (#RRGGBB), beacon_green (#RRGGBB)

## Machine Call Contract
contract_version: 1
json_flag: --json
schema_command: archcast __schema
interactive: false
exit_codes: 0=ok, 1=runtime, 2=usage, 3=input, 5=partial
artifact_roles: report-html, diagram-svg, doc-markdown, diagram-png, diagram-gif, spec-yaml, theme-yaml, log
sidecar_log: <output_dir>/archcast.log (for render and extract)
